topic: Why traffic jams appear out of nowhere

through_line.name: red brake-light clay strip
through_line.progression: one red clay dot, then two dots, then a chained red clay strip, then the strip sliding backwards against traffic
through_line.resolution: a wide gap kept by the lavender car snips the red clay strip apart

blocks.vo_line: This enormous traffic jam has no cause. Drive to its very front and you'll find no accident, no roadwork, just cars accelerating away.
blocks.through_line_state: one red clay dot stamped on the asphalt behind the stopped cars
shots: WIDE high overhead: three clay lanes packed with stalled clay cars, slow push-in
CU low angle: a stopped sand-beige car's tail lights flick red with a stamp
MEDIUM lateral tracking: the camera glides past the queue toward the jam's front
ECU top-down: a single red clay dot stamps onto the asphalt
MEDIUM high angle: at the front the blue car pulls away onto empty road and settles
blocks.audio: soft clay squish as the camera pushes in, a low toy-engine hum bed, a crisp clay thud as the red dot stamps down, a quick whoosh as the blue car pulls away

blocks.vo_line: In two thousand eight, Japanese researchers placed twenty-two cars on a circular track and instructed drivers to cruise at thirty kilometres per hour.
blocks.through_line_state: the red clay dot rests on the ring while every car cruises evenly
shots: WIDE overhead: clay cars slide onto a circular clay track one after another
MEDIUM low angle: evenly spaced cars roll past the inner curb
CU lateral: the blue car rolls steadily, its wheels turning
ECU macro: the red clay dot sits motionless on the track edge
MEDIUM high angle: the whole ring circulates smoothly, then settles into rhythm
blocks.audio: soft clay pops as cars drop onto the track one by one, a steady toy-engine hum bed, light ticking of turning wheels

blocks.vo_line: Smooth driving lasted only briefly, because whenever one motorist eased off slightly, the follower behind reacted late and braked noticeably harder.
blocks.through_line_state: a second red dot snaps down beside the first as a follower brakes
shots: CU lateral: the blue car eases off and a gap opens ahead of it
MEDIUM low angle: the sand-beige car behind closes in fast
ECU rear view: the sand-beige car's brake lights flare red with a hard stamp
MEDIUM top-down: a second red clay dot snaps beside the first
WIDE high angle: the trackside curve shows the cars bunching, then holds steady
blocks.audio: a short squeaky brake scrape, a whoosh as the gap opens, a firm clay thud on the brake flare and the second red dot

blocks.vo_line: Each next driver braked a little harder still, so that one tiny wobble kept growing until it became a full stop-and-go wave.
blocks.through_line_state: the red dots chain into one long strip running down the column
shots: WIDE lateral: a long column of clay cars rolls along a single clay lane
CU rear view: tail lights flare one after another, each a beat later
ECU top-down: red clay dots snap together into a chain
MEDIUM low angle: the last car jolts to a full stop with a bump
WIDE high overhead: the red clay strip stretches the whole column and settles
blocks.audio: rolling toy-engine rumble bed, quick ticks on each tail-light flare, a soft squelch as the dots join, a bump thud on the full stop

blocks.vo_line: Here's the surprise: the wave travels backwards, and on real highways jams drift upstream at roughly fifteen to twenty kilometres an hour.
blocks.through_line_state: the red clay strip slides backwards down the chart while the car tokens move forwards
shots: WIDE overhead: clay car tokens slide upward along grooved clay lanes
CU top-down: the red clay strip curls and slides downward, against the cars
MEDIUM low angle: a clay arrow pointing backwards stamps onto the clay board
ECU macro: the clay strip's edge creeps backwards across the grid lines
MEDIUM high angle: cars climb as the red clay band sinks, then everything settles
blocks.audio: soft sliding clay sounds as tokens climb, a slow sticky clay stretch as the strip slides back, a clay thud as the arrow lands

blocks.vo_line: Later experiments showed one smoothly driven car can calm these waves, so the jam's only cause, and cure, might be you.
blocks.through_line_state: the lavender car's wide gap snips the red clay strip apart
shots: MEDIUM low lateral: the lavender car cruises steadily with a wide gap ahead
CU high angle: the empty asphalt gap between the lavender car and the car ahead
ECU top-down: the red clay strip snaps apart into scraps
MEDIUM roadside: traffic behind flows evenly past the camera
WIDE high angle: the whole highway moves freely and settles into a calm final frame
blocks.audio: calm toy-engine hum bed, a soft clay snap as the red strip breaks apart, a gentle whoosh of flowing cars
